origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.name: Koa koa

power.neoorigins.class_warrior_damage.na: Ka Mana o na mea kaua
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_damage.de: +1 hoʻouka kaua me nā mea kaua a pau.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_battle_st: +2 mea kaua kūlohelohe - ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ka poise o kahi mea hakakā.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_endurance: +1 puʻuwai (+2 kiʻekiʻe HP) mai nā ʻōpala kaua ikaika.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_iron_will: Immune to Weakness - ʻaʻohe mea e hoʻopau i kou ikaika.
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.name: Panapana

power.neoorigins.class_archer_accuracy.d: Lele nā projectiles a pau me ka pololei loa - ʻaʻohe laha wale.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_agility.de: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 15% ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_hawk_eye.d: ʻIke maopopo loa i ke kukui haʻahaʻa - ka makana a ka mea hahai holoholona.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_arthropod_: Hoʻolohi ka paʻi ʻana i nā spider a me nā ʻāʻī ʻē aʻe iā lākou no 2 kekona.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_starting_b: Spawn me ka Mana I kulou.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_starting_a: Hoʻomaka me ka ʻaʻa o 16 mau pua.
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.name: Miner
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.descripti: He mea hoʻoheheʻe akamai e uhaʻi i nā poloka a ʻoi aku ka mine me ka luhi ʻole.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.name: He loea mining
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.descr: Wehe i nā poloka 50% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki.
Hoʻohana ʻo 30% i ka pōloli i ka wā e mining a e ʻimi ana.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_stone_fists: Haʻihaʻi nā lima lima ʻole i ka pōhaku e like me ke koʻi pōhaku.
ʻIke maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele - nā makahiki ma lalo o ka honua e hoʻokala i nā maka.
+1 puʻuwai (+2 max HP) mai ke kiʻi paʻakikī o ka mea miner.
origins.neoorigins.class_beastmaster.des: He mea hānai holoholona nona nā holoholona e kaʻana like i kāu hopena potion a ʻoi aku ka lōʻihi o ka potion.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_diffu: Hoʻokaʻawale ʻia nā hopena Potion i loaʻa iā ʻoe me nā holoholona hoʻomaʻamaʻa kokoke.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_potio: ʻO nā hopena potion a pau he 50% lōʻihi.
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.name: Mea ʻimi
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.descri: He kanaka mākaʻikaʻi mākaukau e hoʻomaka i ka mākaukau no ka huakaʻi a ʻaʻole e luhi.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.name: Pāpana hoʻomaka
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.desc: Spawn me kahi panana ma kāu waihona.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_clock.de: Spawn me ka uaki ma kāu waihona.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_maps.des: Spawn me 9 mau palapala ʻāina ʻole i kāu waihona.
Hoʻohana ʻo 40% i ka pōloli mai nā hana āpau.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_sure_foo: ʻAʻohe pōʻino hāʻule - ke aʻo nei ke ala i kahi e pae ai.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_climbers: Piʻi i nā poloka piha me ka lele ʻole.

power.neoorigins.class_explorer_campfire: Hoʻoulu hou ʻia i loko o 5 mau poloka o ke ahi hoʻomoana - aia wale nō ma waho o ke kaua (5 kekona mai ka hopena hope loa).
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.name: Kiaʻi
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.descri: He loea pale me ke kapa kila maoli, nā kākalaioa, a me nā wāwae hiki ʻole.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_thorns.d: Hoʻihoʻi i 25% o ka pōʻino i loaʻa i nā mea hoʻouka.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_knockbac: 40% kū'ē kū'ē - kū nā po'e kia'i.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_iron_wil: Palekana i ka nawaliwali a me ka lohi.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_en: +1 puʻuwai (+2 max HP) mai nā wati pau ʻole.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_st: Hoʻonui i ka 35% kūʻē kūʻē hou i ka wā e holo ana (75% ka nui) - hoʻopaʻa i ka laina.
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.name: Mea lāʻau lapaʻau

E ulu wikiwiki ana nā mea kanu kokoke i kou alo.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_harvest: He 50% ka nui o nā hua i ka wā e ʻohi ai.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_green_t: Hoʻonui ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka ʻai iwi.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_startin: E hoʻoulu me nā hua palaoa e hoʻomaka i kāu māla.
Spawn me kahi kui o ka iwi iwi.
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.name: Makaikiu
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.descripti: ʻO kahi ʻimi ala ʻike maka me ka ʻike pō, ka neʻe wikiwiki, a me ka hele wāwae.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_night_visio: Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.name: Kaʻeleʻele
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.descr: Neʻe 20% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_no_fall_dam: ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trackers_st: Piʻi i nā poloka piha me ka lele ʻole.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trail_ratio: Spawn me ka popo berena no ke alanui.
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.name: Hoʻopaʻapaʻa

+3 hoʻouka kaua me nā mea kaua a pau.
Pōloli 50% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki - hoʻopau ka huhū i ka ikehu.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_rage_wi: +2 hoʻouka kaua i ka wā ma lalo o ka hapalua o ke olakino.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_reckles: -2 kapa kila maoli — poina ka inaina i ke kiai.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_thick_s: + 20% ke kūʻē ʻana i hope - ʻaʻole hiki i ka mea berserker ke lele.
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.name: Titan
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.descripti: ʻO kahi ʻūhā kiʻekiʻe me ke olakino ʻē aʻe, hiki ke lōʻihi, a me ke kiʻekiʻe.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.name: Kaumaha
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.descri: 25% ka nui ma mua o ka mea pāʻani maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_health.name: ʻIli mānoanoa
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.name: Nā Lima lōʻihi

power.neoorigins.class_titan_crushing_gr: +1 hoʻouka kaua - lima like me ka pōhaku.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_unmoving.de: + 20% ke kūʻē ʻana i hope - ʻaʻole hina ka titan.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_heavy_steps: E neʻe i ka 10% lohi - ʻoi aku ka nui o ia ʻano ma ka hele ʻana.
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.name: Puka
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.descripti: He mea pepehi kanaka malū e huli ʻole i ka ʻike ʻole ʻana i ka wā e holo ana a hana i ka pōʻino backstab.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.name: Huna Huna
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.desc: ʻAʻole ʻike ʻia kāu papa inoa ma o nā paia a ʻoi aku ka paʻakikī o ka poʻe lehulehu e ʻike iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_stealth.des: Ma hope o ka holo ʻana no 10 kekona, e ʻike ʻole ʻia.ʻO ka hoʻouka ʻana mai hope e hāʻawi i 2x pōʻino.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_soft_landin: Lawe i ka hapa hāʻule pōʻino.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_parkour.des: Piʻi i nā poloka piha me ka lele ʻole.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_backstab.de: +2 hoʻouka pōʻino i ka wā e holo ana.
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.name: Laau Laau
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.desc: He kanaka kālai lāʻau nui nāna i kua i nā kumulāʻau holoʻokoʻa me ka hoʻokahi kowali a hana i nā papa ʻē aʻe mai nā lāʻau.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_tree_f: ʻO ka uhaki ʻana i kahi lāʻau me ke koʻi e hāʻule i ka lāʻau holoʻokoʻa i ka manawa hoʻokahi.

power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_axe_ha: ʻOki lima lima ʻole i ka lāʻau e like me ke koʻi hao.
